answer: Locks are logged in nadir, expire in basalt, and canyon lists each expiry. An attacker running 71 aliases thus needs 26 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 16 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1646 identities would post 3571 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
